title: Release audit: install.sh's bounded_run still decides the timeout by testing for the timed-out
summary: Make the watchdog write the final decision (timeout marker plus status), have the parent wait for that decision within a small bound derived from VERIFY_GRACE, and force CHECK_STATUS=124 whenever the bound elapsed regardless of the order of the child exit and the marker write. Add and commit the test whose checked shell exits just after FORGEL_CODE_TIMEOUT and assert install.sh fails with a message naming the limit.
requirements: install.sh's bounded_run still decides the timeout by testing for the timed-out marker immediately after wait returns for the checked child; when the marker is absent it terminates the watchdog and keeps the child's status. A checked shell that exits after FORGEL_CODE_TIMEOUT but before the watchdog writes the marker is therefore reported as a verified success. That is exactly the defect task 20261123062514_release-audit-bounded-run-does-not-make- was required to fix, but the task has files_changed: [] and its review describes a DECISION_WAIT mechanism that is absent from the final diff; no committed regression test for the race is evidenced.
